name: io.github.CleanDataLabs/samgov-opportunities
title: SAM.gov Opportunities
description: Search SAM.gov federal contract opportunities by NAICS, PSC, set-aside, agency, state and date.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Apify API token (console.apify.com > Settings > API & Integrations). Runs are billed to this account at $0.003 per notice.

environmentVariables.name: SAMGOV_MAX_CHARGE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per tool call in USD (default 0.30).

environmentVariables.name: SAMGOV_ACTOR_BUILD
environmentVariables.description: Actor build tag to run (default latest).
